newsitem.title: USA: Nu Skin Asia Pacific registers offering.
newsitem.headline: Nu Skin Asia Pacific registers offering.

text.p: Nu Skin Asia Pacific Inc said it filed a registration statement for its initial public offering of common stock with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The offering is scheduled to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange near the end of November.
The Company said it also intends to file a registration statement in Japan.

Nu Skin Asia is offering 7.6 million shares of Class A common stock to the public in this initial offering. Of these shares, 4.6 million shares will be available in the United States and Canada, 1.67 million shares in Japan, and the remaining 1.33 million shares will be made available internationally.

Net proceeds from this offering will be about $91 million, it said. Proceeds will be used for development of new Asian markets and to expand existing operations, introduce new products and enhance technology infrastructure.
Funds will also be used to repay a portion of accumulated and undistributed earnings to stockholders and for other operating expenses.
